about.description: sALTS is the tokenized wrapper for ALT5 Sigma Corporation (Nasdaq: ALTS), the fintech that pivoted to become the flagship WLFI (World Liberty Financial) Digital Asset Treasury company, holding in excess of $1.5B of WLFI. Chairman is Zach Witkoff and the board includes Eric Trump. StableStock issues sALTS as a 1:1 BEP-20 on BNB Chain with shares custodied off-chain through StableBroker (StableStock's licensed broker partner with HabitTrade), and 24/7 on-chain liquidity in partnership with Native. KYC gates mint/redeem. The BEP-20 transfers without restriction, giving BSC DeFi users direct on-chain exposure to the WLFI-treasury thesis.
